context.title: Californians for Voter ID: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: California — Proposition 39 (Prohibits Citizens from Voting Unless They Present Government-Issued Identification)

positions.statement: Margit Whitlock (Democratic Coalition Chair) and Tafa Jefferson (Republican Coalition Chair) and Joe Green (Independent Coalition Chair) signed the argument in favor of Proposition 39 in the official voter guide.
